description: Bounded canonical lowercase-UUID sync-job status GET 429 requests reaching any Cloud Run service. Fixed endpoint identity encoded by metric definition; excludes edge-denied requests and does not count total polls. No path/ID labels.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND logName="projects/based-hardware/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.requestMethod="GET" AND httpRequest.status=429 AND httpRequest.requestUrl =~ "^https?://[^/?#]+/v2/sync-local-files/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}(?:[?][^#]*)?$"
